SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm, good!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯，好啊！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯，很好！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい、いいですよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hmm, bagus!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Claro, ótima ideia.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم، خوب!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Nice thinking, Yuman.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你做了正确的决定，吴宥万
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你做出了很好的決定，吳宥萬
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: よく考えた、ユマン
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oke juga mikirnya, Yuman.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tomou uma boa decisão, Yuman.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Has tomado una buena decisión, Yumán.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فکر خوبی است، یومان.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Let’s go!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 走吧！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 走吧！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 行こう！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ayo jalan!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vamos!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: برویم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: How was it coming back to work after a while?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 时隔这么久上班感觉怎么样？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 隔了這麼久來上班，感覺怎麼樣？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 久々に出勤してどうだった？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Gimana rasanya balik kerja lagi setelah sekian lama?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como se sente voltando ao escritório depois de tanto tempo?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Cómo te sientes al volver a la oficina después de tanto tiempo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بعد از مدتی چطور بود که سر کار برگشت؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Huh?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hah?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ها؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 쉬다가 갑자기 회사 일 하려니까 쉽지 않았지?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It must’ve been tough suddenly jumping back into company work after some time off, right?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 休息久了突然回公司工作，不太适应吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 休息完突然要開始上班，應該不容易吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 久しぶりに仕事戻ったら、やっぱり大変でしょ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Pasti agak berat ya, langsung nyemplung lagi ke kerjaan kantor setelah cuti.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Deve ter sido difícil voltar ao trabalho depois do afastamento.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Debe haber sido difícil volver al trabajo después de tu descanso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پس از مدتی مرخصی باید ناگهان به کار شرکت بازگردید، درست است؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 네… 일도 그렇고 사람도 달라져 있고.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, yes… between the work and the people changing…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，是的…工作也生疏了，同事也变了不少
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，是啊... 不只是工作，連同事都換了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、はい…仕事も、人も変わってて
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, iya… apalagi kerjaannya dan orang-orangnya juga udah berubah…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, sim… o trabalho e as pessoas, tudo parece um pouco diferente.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, sí… el trabajo y las personas, todos es un poco diferente.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، بله… بین کار و تغییر مردم…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 뭐야, 왜 갑자기 약한 소리를 해?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What’s with the sudden weak voice?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怎么回事，怎么突然说这种泄气话？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼啊，怎麼突然說喪氣話？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: どうしたの、急に弱気だね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kok suara kamu jadi lemes gitu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que foi? Por que tá com essa voz desanimada?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صدای ضعیف ناگهانی چیه؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그게, 뭔가 요청하신 거 척척 해내고 싶었는데…
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Well… I wanted to handle everything you asked smoothly…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 就是…本想好好完成您交代的工作…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 就是，我很想把你要求的事情都處理得完美...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんか…課長の指示、もっとスムーズにこなしたかったんですけど
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Soalnya… aku pengen ngerjain semua yang Manajer minta dengan lancar…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É que eu queria ter cumprido tudo o que a senhora pediu, mas...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Es que quería cumplir con todo lo que me pidió, pero…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خب… من می‌خواستم همه چیزهایی را که می‌پرسیدی راحت انجام دهم…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: but I feel like I didn’t do so well.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 但总觉得做得不够好
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 但好像做得不太好
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うまくいかなかった気がして
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: tapi rasanya belum maksimal.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: sinto que não fiz direito.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: siento que no lo hice bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما احساس می کنم آنقدرها خوب کار نکردم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 吳宥萬
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yuman.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Yuman.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یومان.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만 씨가 언제는 뭐 잘했었는 줄 알아?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: When have you ever not done well?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你有真的“做得很好”的时候吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你什麼時候有做得很好了嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あなたがいつも完璧にやってたと思う？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kapan sih kamu pernah nggak bagus?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Acha que antes fazia tudo perfeitamente?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چه زمانی تا به حال خوب کار نکرده اید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You always put it that way…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 您这话说的…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 怎麼這樣說...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: またまたそんな言い方を…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Manajer selalu bilang gitu…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A senhora tá falando assim de novo...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: همیشه اینطوری میگی…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Everyone learns from their mistakes.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 大家都是摸着石头过河的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 大家都是從錯誤中學習的啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 誰だって失敗しながら学ぶもの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Setiap orang belajar dari kesalahan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Todos aprendemos errando.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: همه از اشتباهات خود درس می گیرند.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 결정적으로 유만 씨, 그렇게 못 하지도 않아
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And ultimately, Yuman, you’re not incapable.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 关键是，你其实做得并不差
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 而且最重要的是，你也沒有做得那麼差
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それに、ユマンさんは全然できてないわけじゃないよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan pada akhirnya, Yuman, kamu itu bukan orang yang nggak bisa.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E além disso, Yuman, você não é do tipo que desiste fácil.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Y además, Yumán, tú no eres de los que se rinden tan fácilmente.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و در نهایت، یومان، تو ناتوان نیستی.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Manager…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 科长…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 課長...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 課長…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Manajer…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Chefe…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مدیر…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t you remember?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万，你还记得吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 宥萬，你不記得了嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん、覚えてない？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Inget nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não lembra o que disse quando te contratamos?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿No recuerdas lo que dijiste cuando te contratamos?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یادت نمیاد؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 처음 입사할 때 적당히 하는 사람이 되고 싶다고 했잖아.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: When you first joined, you said you wanted to be someone who does things reasonably.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 入职时你说想成为“差不多就行的人”
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 剛進公司的時候，你說想成為一個「剛剛好就好」的人
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 最初に入社したとき、ほどほどにやる人になりたいって言ってたでしょ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Waktu kamu baru masuk, kamu bilang pengen jadi orang yang kerja dengan wajar.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Que queria ser alguém que fizesse as coisas bem o bastante.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Que querías ser alguien que hiciera las cosas lo suficientemente bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: وقتی برای اولین بار به عضویت در آمدید، گفتید که می خواهید فردی باشید که کارها را به طور معقول انجام دهد.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Doing things reasonably is the most important.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 能做到差不多就行，已经很厉害了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這才是最重要的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほどほどが一番大事なの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan bekerja dengan wajar itu justru yang paling penting.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Isso é o mais importante.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: انجام کارها به طور معقول مهمترین چیز است.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yes! I’ll work hard.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 明白了！我会继续努力的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是！我會努力的！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい！頑張ります！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Siap! Aku bakal kerja lebih keras lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim! Vou dar o meu melhor.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بله! سخت کار خواهم کرد
